proofs.text: Open the regulated fixture and open `RULE-4`, whose proof is scoped to one operating system with no record from it; verify the screen reads `windows: no record yet` and does not read `no negative case`

rule_text: A rule whose proof names an operating system that no counting record came from says so on its screen, naming that system, rather than reading as proved

tests.body:
def test_a_rule_waiting_on_an_operating_system_says_so(browser, tmp_path):
    page = open_board(browser, tmp_path, payload_named('regulated'))
    page.click('[data-act="feature"][data-feature="login"]')
    page.click('.rule[data-rule="RULE-4"]')
    body = page.inner_text('.wrap')
    assert 'windows: no record yet' in body
    assert 'no negative case' not in body
    page.close()
tests.name: test_a_rule_waiting_on_an_operating_system_says_so
